description.short: Find, enrich and reach the right people in your Oneprofile workspace
description.full:
Oneprofile is a go-to-market workspace: you build lists of companies and people, fill them in with researched facts, and write to the ones worth writing to, by email and LinkedIn. This connector lets Copilot do that work in your Oneprofile workspace from a conversation.

What you can ask for:
- Find people or companies by title, seniority, industry, size, location, technology or funding, or find companies that look like your best customers. Most searches are counted for free before anything is saved.
- Save the matches to a table, or bring in a pasted list, a file or records from a connected CRM such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive or Attio, and send results back to your CRM or out as CSV.
- Fill in work emails, phone numbers and company details, or research each row with AI: fit against your ideal customer, company and person research, and personalized openers.
- Build an email and LinkedIn sequence for a table, preview the messages it will send, and clear what blocks its launch.
- Work through replies: summarize what came in, label conversations, and draft answers.
- Report how your outreach is doing, including replies, positive replies, bounces and credits left.

How it works: Copilot acts as you, in the one Oneprofile workspace you pick when you sign in, with the everyday tools of the AI Assistant inside Oneprofile. Each tool does one job and says whether it only looks things up, changes your workspace, or can send to people or remove something, so you can approve each one on its own. Actions that spend your workspace's Oneprofile credits say the price they ran at, and Oneprofile asks Copilot to tell you the price and wait for your go-ahead before spending.

Requirements: You need a Oneprofile account. A read-only connection can look things up; making changes spends your workspace's credits. Email sends from a connected Google Workspace mailbox, and LinkedIn steps run in your browser through the Oneprofile extension.
